messages:
Ana Kovacs: Hi folks  I'm Ana, starting today on Platform UX! I draw a lot (sketchbooks everywhere) and bring sourdough on special occasions. Quick Q: is there a place to pin small prints/doodles in the office? Also 😅 I cycle in so curious where people stash helmets.
Tom (Design): Welcome Ana!! :tada: We have a community corkboard by the north stairwell for prints and zines — small stuff sticks right on. For helmets, a few people hang them on the coat hooks by the bike racks in the basement. Pro tip: put a little name sticker if you worry about mixups.
Ana Kovacs: Amazing, thanks Tom. I will bring a tiny zine this week. Also, is there a weekly team lunch for design folks or should I RSVP to the general new-hire one?
Mira Patel: Hey Ana  there's a weekly design lunch on Wednesdays in the 2nd-floor common area, but new-hire lunch is Friday 12:30 — both are great. I'll DM you the invite for Wednesday so you can meet a few folks early.
Sam (People Ops): Welcome Ana! Lunch RSVP (Friday) is open until Thursday 5pm: https://intranet/redwood/lunch-rsvp. Also we've queued your laptop order and badge access; expect a badge-ready email from facilities in ~30 mins. If you want any ergonomic kit (wrist rest, laptop stand) file in #devex-help and tag me.
Ana Kovacs: Sweet — badge email arrived. Thanks Sam! Also curious: are plant swaps still a thing? I have a tiny variegated peperomia that needs a new home if anyone's down.
DevEx Bot: Automated note: New hire checklist created for Ana Kovacs. Onboarding docs: https://docs.redwood/onboarding  Swag / sticker requests: https://forms.redwood/swag
Tom (Design): Plant swap yes! We do informal swaps in #plants every other Wednesday. Bring that peperomia  and also please bring baked goods if you're offering sourdough, that always helps with introductions.
Ana Kovacs: Haha will do — tiny peperomia + half-boule for the team next week. Thanks everyone for the warm welcome, see you all around :wave:
